source_caption:
🎬 Flamin’ Hot (2023)

Flamin’ Hot follows Richard Montañez, a hardworking Frito-Lay janitor who dreams of creating a better future for his family. Growing up facing poverty and discrimination, Richard struggles to find opportunities but refuses to let his circumstances define him. Inspired by his Mexican-American heritage and encouraged by his supportive wife Judy, he develops a bold idea to bring spicy flavors to the snack industry. Determined to prove himself, Richard takes a chance by presenting his concept to company executives, hoping to transform his career and change his family’s future. Based on Montañez’s account of his life, the film celebrates ambition, perseverance, cultural pride, and the power of believing in yourself, although his claim of inventing Flamin’ Hot Cheetos has been disputed.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Comedy • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 39m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Eva Longoria

✍️ Writers: Lewis Colick & Linda Yvette Chávez

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu and Disney+ in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Flamin' Hot is a 2023 American biographical comedy-drama film directed by Eva Longoria in her feature-length directorial debut. Written by Linda Yvette Chávez and Lewis Colick, it is based on the memoir A Boy, a Burrito and a Cookie: From Janitor to Executive by Richard Montañez, who claims to (but is entirely debunked) have invented Flamin' Hot Cheetos. The film stars Jesse Garcia, Annie Gonzalez, Dennis Haysbert, and Tony Shalhoub. The film had its world premiere at South by Southwest on March 11, 2023.
